funds_data.description: The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its assets directly or indirectly in the securities included in the Nasdaq Victory U.S. Large Cap 500 Volatility Weighted Index, an unmanaged, volatility weighted index maintained exclusively by the index provider. The index identifies the 500 largest U.S. stocks by market capitalization measured at the time the index's constituent securities are determined.
